changeSet.sql: WITH accounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM aviation_rpt_reportable_emissions UNION SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM account_aviation_reporting_status_history ), emission_bounds AS ( SELECT a.account_id, MIN(e.year) AS first_emission_year FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN aviation_rpt_reportable_emissions e ON e.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id ), account_years AS ( SELECT account_id, generate_series( COALESCE(first_emission_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int ) AS year FROM emission_bounds ), emissions_flag AS ( SELECT ay.account_id, ay.year, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aviation_rpt_reportable_emissions ar WHERE ar.account_id = ay.account_id AND ar.year = ay.year ) AS has_emissions FROM account_years ay ), current_status AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (account_id) account_id, status FROM account_aviation_reporting_status_history ORDER BY account_id, submission_date DESC ), status_by_year AS ( SELECT arsh.account_id, COALESCE(arsh.year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM arsh.submission_date)::int) AS year, arsh.status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY arsh.account_id, COALESCE(arsh.year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM arsh.submission_date)::int) ORDER BY arsh.submission_date DESC ) AS rn FROM account_aviation_reporting_status_history arsh ), final_status AS ( SELECT ef.account_id, ef.year, CASE -- 1.Emissions exist WHEN ef.has_emissions THEN 'REQUIRED_TO_REPORT' -- 2. There are no emissions + current exempt WHEN cs.status IN ('EXEMPT_COMMERCIAL', 'EXEMPT_NON_COMMERCIAL') THEN cs.status -- 3. There are no emissions + current REQUIRED ELSE COALESCE(sby.status, 'REQUIRED_TO_REPORT') END AS reporting_status FROM emissions_flag ef JOIN current_status cs ON cs.account_id = ef.account_id LEFT JOIN status_by_year sby ON sby.account_id = ef.account_id AND sby.year = ef.year + 1 AND sby.rn = 1 ) INSERT INTO account_aviation_reporting_status ( id, account_id, year, status ) SELECT nextval('account_aviation_reporting_status_seq'), account_id, year, reporting_status FROM final_status

changeSet.comment: Rename operatorDetails.firstKnownAviationActivity to firstYearOfReportingObligation and store it as an integer year
changeSet.sql: UPDATE request_action SET payload = jsonb_set( payload #- ARRAY['operatorDetails','firstKnownAviationActivity']::text[], ARRAY['operatorDetails','firstYearOfReportingObligation']::text[], to_jsonb( EXTRACT( YEAR FROM (payload #>> ARRAY['operatorDetails','firstKnownAviationActivity']::text[])::date )::int ), true ) WHERE type = 'EMP_ISSUANCE_UKETS_ACCOUNT_CREATED_SENT_TO_REGISTRY' AND payload ->> 'payloadType' = 'EMP_ISSUANCE_UKETS_REGISTRY_INTEGRATION_ACCOUNT_CREATED_PAYLOAD' AND payload #>> ARRAY['operatorDetails','firstKnownAviationActivity']::text[] IS NOT NULL;
